amendments.what: add-ruling {"question": "Q-purpose", "resolution": "Priori-tree is a generalized prioritization system: for any list and comparison operator, run the pairwise permutations, store the votes, tally — the output list is in a superior order than sizing individual items, because discernment between two items is easy (for humans and LLMs) while absolute sizing is not.", "ruling": "PURPOSE (collaborator ruling 2026-11-19, verbatim): \"Priori-tree is a generalized prioritization system based on the concept that LLM and Humans are great at discerning the difference between two items but not great at sizing an item. That is a simplification. Consider: a human is great at determining that a basketball is larger than a grapefruit. But not great as identifying the exact dimensions of a grapefruit or a basketball. By taking a list and running through the pairwise permutations for any given comparision operator. Storing the votes, then tallying. we get a list out that is in a superior order than trying to size individual items.\" The comparator class is both human AND LLM — both vote through the same vote interface; the tally is a pure function of the stored votes.", "status": "ruled"}
amendments.why: junro route-op provenance stamp (design-spec §6: every route op stamps actor, timestamp, and arguments into the route's amendments)

amendments.what: add-ruling {"question": "Q-setup-arch", "resolution": "All four forms layered library-first: the src/prioritree pure-logic core at the bottom, CLI over it, FastAPI service over that, web app on top — the setup builds the skeleton and the core library is the product effort's first increment. Pure logic at birth (no DB); Makefile floor (dev/test/lint); GitHub project, CI determined later.", "ruling": "SETUP ARCHITECTURE (collaborator ruling 2026-11-19): Primary form = ALL FOUR — Python library, CLI tool, API service (FastAPI), web app — one layered architecture, library-first: src/prioritree carries the pure-logic core (items, comparison operator, pair scheduling, votes, tally); the CLI wraps it; the FastAPI service serves it; the web app fronts the service (the human comparator's vote surface). The setup effort builds the skeleton only — the core library is the PRODUCT effort's first increment, born after setup completes. Data plane = pure logic: stateless scoring/ranking core, votes are data in/out, no DB at birth (persistence is a service-tier design ruling for the product effort). CI = deferred: prioritree is a GitHub project; CI is determined later — git hooks and local gates stand in at birth.", "status": "ruled"}

open_questions.question: What is prioritree — the product's core mechanism and purpose?

rulings.text: PURPOSE (collaborator ruling 2026-11-19, verbatim): "Priori-tree is a generalized prioritization system based on the concept that LLM and Humans are great at discerning the difference between two items but not great at sizing an item. That is a simplification. Consider: a human is great at determining that a basketball is larger than a grapefruit. But not great as identifying the exact dimensions of a grapefruit or a basketball. By taking a list and running through the pairwise permutations for any given comparision operator. Storing the votes, then tallying. we get a list out that is in a superior order than trying to size individual items." The comparator class is both human AND LLM — both vote through the same vote interface; the tally is a pure function of the stored votes.

open_questions.resolution: Priori-tree is a generalized prioritization system: for any list and comparison operator, run the pairwise permutations, store the votes, tally — the output list is in a superior order than sizing individual items, because discernment between two items is easy (for humans and LLMs) while absolute sizing is not.

rulings.text: SETUP ARCHITECTURE (collaborator ruling 2026-11-19): Primary form = ALL FOUR — Python library, CLI tool, API service (FastAPI), web app — one layered architecture, library-first: src/prioritree carries the pure-logic core (items, comparison operator, pair scheduling, votes, tally); the CLI wraps it; the FastAPI service serves it; the web app fronts the service (the human comparator's vote surface). The setup effort builds the skeleton only — the core library is the PRODUCT effort's first increment, born after setup completes. Data plane = pure logic: stateless scoring/ranking core, votes are data in/out, no DB at birth (persistence is a service-tier design ruling for the product effort). Build system = Makefile floor (dev/test/lint — the hikari idiom; room for service targets later). CI = deferred: prioritree is a GitHub project; CI is determined later — git hooks and local gates stand in at birth.

open_questions.resolution: All four forms layered library-first: the src/prioritree pure-logic core at the bottom, CLI over it, FastAPI service over that, web app on top — the setup builds the skeleton and the core library is the product effort's first increment. Pure logic at birth (no DB); Makefile floor (dev/test/lint); GitHub project, CI determined later.
